description: ai-usagebar test builds from the djalmajr fork (Windows tray, TUI, CLI). For trying unreleased changes; use 'ai-usagebar' for upstream releases
notes: This is a fork test build, not a release of akitaonrails/ai-usagebar. Install 'ai-usagebar' instead unless you are testing.
Start the tray with 'ai-usagebar-tray' or the Start Menu shortcut 'AI Usage (dev)'; update with 'scoop update ai-usagebar-dev' or from the tray's Settings.
post_uninstall: Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\Control Panel\NotifyIconSettings' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $icon = Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath; if ($icon.ExecutablePath -like "$root\*") { Remove-Item $_.PSPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
